caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, symmetrical decorative element rendered in shades of gray on an off-white or cream-colored background. The central section features a large, intricate finial with scrollwork and leaf motifs extending upward, flanked on both sides by mirrored, scrolling acanthus leaves. Curved ornamental forms extend outward and downward from the center, each ending in a stylized animal head with open mouths facing outward. The drawing is composed horizontally, with the base depicted as a solid, textured horizontal band. The overall design is triangular, with the highest point in the center and tapering down to the sides. There is a faint rectangular border outlining the composition near the edges of the paper, and in the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature and date: “J. Howard Iams 1938.”
title: Cast Iron Gate Top
